summary: Comprehensive testing of AR360 E-Commerce Platform after Node.js to FastAPI rebuild. Found and fixed critical product detail page bug (MongoDB ObjectId parsing issue). All 32 backend API tests pass. Frontend functioning correctly with all 69 products displayed.

issues: Watch image is not relevant to exercise recovery products - appears to be placeholder

bugs_fixed.issue: Product detail page showing 'Product Not Found' for valid products
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Line 26: parseInt(id) was converting MongoDB ObjectId string to integer, truncating the ID to just the first numeric part. Example: '69a74a0ce5b1b6ab1265062f' became '69'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed from 'const productId = parseInt(id)' to 'const productId = id' to keep ID as string

bugs_fixed.issue: Cart functions used number types for IDs
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Type definitions used 'number' instead of 'string' for productId and cartItemId
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated all ID type parameters from 'number' to 'string' for MongoDB ObjectId compatibility

context_for_next_testing_agent: FastAPI backend with JWT auth fully working. Product detail page bug fixed (MongoDB ObjectId parsing). Cart functionality requires membership. Firebase auth is the primary frontend login method.
rca_of_the_issue: Product detail page showed 'Product Not Found' because parseInt() was used on MongoDB ObjectId strings. MongoDB ObjectIds like '69a74a0ce5b1b6ab1265062f' when parsed as integers return just '69' (first numeric sequence before 'a'). The fix was to keep the ID as a string since MongoDB ObjectIds are hex strings, not integers.
